collectionMethod: Authenticated Keyword Planner UI. Visible seed rows and selected visible suggestions, not a complete export of generated ideas.

accountSafetyObservation.scope: Campaigns screen at the time of inspection, not an audit of billing history

filters.locations: All locations supported by the tool
filters.languageSetting: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French or Indonesian, matching each batch

metric: Displayed range of average monthly searches for the keyword and close variants. Bounds below reproduce the displayed buckets, not precise counts or confidence intervals.

columnDefinitions.monthlyRange: Inclusive-looking UI bucket bounds; do not infer more precision than the original displayed range
columnDefinitions.advertisingCompetition: Competition among advertisers, not organic SEO difficulty
columnDefinitions.quarterChange: Percentage text displayed by Google, retained as an observation, not a forecast
columnDefinitions.yearChange: Percentage text displayed by Google, retained as an observation, not a forecast

queries.query: lire la bible en un an

queries.status: Not displayed among the supplied keyword rows; missing data, not zero demand

limitations: No precise monthly counts were available in the displayed results. Do not use bucket midpoints as measurements.
Close variants and related intents may overlap. Do not sum these ranges into total audience size or visits.
All locations means the scope supported by Google Keyword Planner, not complete coverage of every country or search engine.
The five query languages are exploratory samples, not an exhaustive language ranking. Batch size and wording differ.
Location-level volumes, device splits and monthly seasonality have not been measured in this collection.
The selected language setting is recorded for reproducibility. It is not evidence of a separate, exclusive audience population.
Change percentages from coarse source data are not reliable traffic forecasts. No organic traffic or ranking promise is inferred.
Suggested queries were sampled from visible rows. The thousands of generated ideas were not all read or validated.
Brand names, unsupported Bible translations, audio-only demand and unrelated games must be excluded or reviewed before targeting.
Advertising competition is not organic SEO difficulty. Country-specific search results and product-language readiness still require review.

initialRecommendation.status: Historical proposal before user approval. Superseded by docs/seo-plan.md: launch RU and EN resources on chrust.org independently of the optional app subdomain. No advertising changes made.
initialRecommendation.firstReleaseLanguage: English, conditional on working English app flows. Selected for current website readiness and measured relevant demand, not as a proven highest-value country ranking.

deferredTopics: Prayer journal until the actual feature and search intent fit are verified
Chronological reading until the product supports it
Separate country pages without distinct useful content
launchGates: Confirm the public application entry works and target-language features are ready.
Remove noindex only from approved public pages; retain protection on test and private surfaces.
Publish sitemap and review robots policy, self-canonical URLs, reciprocal hreflang and crawlable links.
Verify Search Console and Yandex Webmaster access with the owner before adding ownership permissions or tags.
Measure search impressions, clicks and completed first meaningful app actions without collecting Bible notes or prayer text.
nextResearch: For each leading intent, measure country splits using the same period and network; do not assume billing country Hong Kong is the audience.
Expand native-language suggestions and inspect actual country-specific search results before approving more locales.
Group synonyms by intent into one useful page rather than publishing a page for every phrase.
Review initial indexed performance after four weeks and prioritize by relevant visits and first meaningful actions, not raw search volume alone.
